metadata.scenario_context: A team is working on a project with a deadline approaching in early May. It is currently May 2nd, and they must finalize their work schedule for the next few days.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from Australia place great importance on Leisure time.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Netherlands place great importance on Leisure time.

agent_1.goal_1: Discuss  the possibility of working on May 1st - May 4th to  complete the tasks.
agent_1.goal_2: Suggest working on May 4th to meet the deadline.

agent_2.goal_1: Discuss the remaining tasks and how to distribute the workload before the deadline.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss whether working on May 4th is feasible.
